text: Make an app that notices when I'm going in circles or using a logical fallacy.
Make an app that tells me to take a pause when voices get loud.
Make an app that reminds me about deadlines when I mention a date.
Make an app that checks if I already have one before building a new one.
Make an app that gently nudges me when I've been on a tangent for too long.
Make an app that reminds me to do a daily recap every evening at six.
